title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1983-04-26
source: flac16/48kHz; Master Soundboard Cassette (Dan Healy)-1st Generation 7 Inch Reel @ 7.5 ips 1/4 Track(Dick L)-Tascam 122MK111 Cassette Deck-Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel); Analog To Digital-Reel Playback on Otari MX5050-JVC SV-3700 DAT Deck @48KHz; DAT x Zero-DAT x One JVC 3700-JVC 3700 via AES cable; DAT x ONE play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/48KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing(iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name) by Jim Wise

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of an all‑time great, smoking 1983 show.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave that this Healy‑sourced tape sounds like one of the crispest recordings they’ve ever heard and praise the performance as a “great” and “smoker from the get‑go.” The soundboard source delivers clear, well‑balanced audio, making the historic concert highly enjoyable despite no specific song details being cited.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 5‑star and highlight both superb recording fidelity and an outstanding performance, indicating a top‑tier show with excellent sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as one of the crispest sounding recordings; clear, well‑balanced playback praised by multiple listeners.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewed as a consistently strong and energetic show – “a great show” and “smoker from the get‑go.”
